All 64 MathArraysTest tests pass.

## Summary

This is iteration 14 of refactoring `MathArrays.java`. The file has been heavily refactored in prior iterations (helper extractions for `checkEqualLength`, `violatesOrder`, `keyComparator`, `applyPermutation`, `floatArraysEqual`/`doubleArraysEqual`, `validateWeight`, `uniformInt`/`swap`, `naiveDotProduct`, `twoProductLow`/`twoSumLow`/`highPart`, etc.).

The remaining improvement I applied:

**Promoted MINPACK constants to class-level `private static final` fields.**

In `safeNorm`, `rdwarf` (3.834e-20) and `rgiant` (1.304e+19) were declared as local `double` variables inside the method. They're true compile-time constants from the MINPACK enorm subroutine — promoting them to `SAFE_NORM_RDWARF`/`SAFE_NORM_RGIANT` static finals with documentation makes their role explicit (underflow/overflow thresholds) and avoids reallocating them on every call.

I also removed the unused `floatn` intermediate (it was just `v.length` cast to double before being used once as the denominator of `rgiant / floatn`) — now inlined as `SAFE_NORM_RGIANT / v.length`.

No public API changes, no numerical behavior changes (the constants and arithmetic are identical), no new dependencies, Java 6/7 compatible.
